rationale: All four findings from the final round are resolved. CR-001 and CR-002 were resolved together by making the auto-lookup write an explicit opt-in from the call site: clearing now records the decision on surfaces that show the switch, while the plugin panel stays flag-neutral. Every caller of both setters was traced — ToolsConfiguration forwards to Toolkit, ExternalToolsSection renders only is_external toolkits whose integration UI is gated off entirely, the MCP path does not use these setters — so no switch-bearing surface omits the opt-in and no switchless surface passes it. CR-003 is resolved: the toolkit-level fixture is keyed by the toolkit's own credential type, the dropdown half is genuinely asserted, and the missing no-flag and clear cases are added. CR-004 was resolved in code and then deliberately reverted: the check round found the fix's own guard could block form initialisation permanently when the integrations index legitimately resolves empty (settingsStore.indexSettings has no catch and leaves an empty object for a user with no integrations), ending in silent loss of the node's tool on save, and that its first population could overwrite edits made in the meantime. Both are worse than the pre-existing race they guarded, so the human chose to revert that scope to its own ticket; the two workflow form files are byte-identical to main again. The check round therefore introduces no new findings against the shipped diff. Manual verification on a running stack confirms the ticket symptom no longer reproduces after the fix.
